  "description": "Elvaridah Limited - Our client in the Beauty, Spa &amp; Wellness industry is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Executive

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Beauty, Spa &amp; Wellness
Working Days: Monday &ndash; Friday
Working Hours: 9:00 AM &ndash; 5:00 PM

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Business Development Executive to drive customer acquisition, partnerships, and revenue growth for our spa and salon.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and corporate partners, promoting the spa and salon&#39;s services, and converting leads into paying customers.
	The successful candidate should have strong communication and relationship-building skills, a good understanding of sales and business development, and a passion for the beauty, wellness, and lifestyle industry.


Key Responsibilities
Business Development &amp; Lead Generation:


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities to increase the spa and salon&#39;s customer base.
	Research and identify potential individual, corporate, and strategic clients within Lekki and surrounding areas.
	Generate leads through networking, referrals, outreach, social media, events, and other relevant channels.
	Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective clients.


Client Acquisition &amp; Sales:


	Present and promote the spa and salon&#39;s services, packages, memberships, and special offers to prospective clients.
	Follow up consistently with leads and convert prospects into paying customers.
	Understand clients&#39; needs and recommend suitable services or packages.
	Work towards achieving agreed sales and customer acquisition targets.
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, conversions, and follow-ups.


Partnerships &amp; Corporate Business:


	Identify and develop partnerships with companies, hotels, gyms, fitness centres, estates, lifestyle brands, and other relevant businesses.
	Explore corporate wellness packages, employee wellness programmes, group bookings, and other partnership opportunities.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with business partners and referral sources.
	Negotiate partnership opportunities within approved business terms.


Client Relationship Management:


	Maintain regular communication with existing and prospective clients.
	Build strong relationships that encourage repeat visits, referrals, and long-term patronage.
	Gather client feedback and communicate relevant insights to management.
	Identify opportunities to increase customer retention and engagement.


Marketing &amp; Business Growth Support:


	Support the development and execution of promotional campaigns and customer acquisition initiatives.
	Participate in networking events, activations, exhibitions, and other activities that can generate business.
	Work closely with the marketing and operations teams to promote services and maximize business opportunities.
	Monitor competitor activities and market trends within the beauty, spa, and wellness industry.


Key Performance Indicators
Performance Indicators Performance will be assessed based on:


	Number and quality of leads generated.
	Conversion of prospects into paying clients.
	Achievement of agreed sales / revenue targets.
	Number and quality of new business partnerships secured.
	Growth in corporate and group bookings.
	Client retention and referrals.
	Effectiveness of business development initiatives.


Requirements


	Minimum of OND / HND / Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
	2&ndash;3 years of experience in business development, sales, customer acquisition, or a related role.
	Experience in the beauty, spa, salon, wellness, hospitality, lifestyle, or related industry is an advantage.
	Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
	Excellent relationship-building and networking abilities.
	Good understanding of sales and business development processes.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and basic CRM or sales tracking tools.
	Must be proactive, target-driven, confident, and commercially minded.


Key Competencies:


	Business development
	Lead generation
	Sales and conversion
	Client relationship management
	Negotiation
	Networking
	Communication and presentation
	Strategic thinking
	Market research
	Target achievement
	Customer retention.


Salary
N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their applications to: careers@elvaridah.com using &quot;Business Development Executive&quot; as the subject of the email.",

Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Beauty, Spa & Wellness
Working Days: Monday – Friday
Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Job Summary

	We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Business Development Executive to drive customer acquisition, partnerships, and revenue growth for our spa and salon.

  "title": "Executive Assistant",
  "description": "Elvaridah Limited - Our client, a fast-growing&nbsp;fitness and wellness company is recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Executive Assistant

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Fully Onsite (Monday to Friday)
Industry: Fitness &amp; Wellness
Work Hours: 8:30am &ndash; 6:00pm

About the Company


	We are a fast-growing fitness and wellness company committed to transforming lives through innovative fitness solutions, exceptional customer experiences, and operational excellence.
	As we continue to scale, we are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and strategic Executive Assistant who can serve as a trusted partner to the executive leadership team.
	This is not a traditional administrative role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, drive execution, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, and ensure priorities are translated into measurable outcomes across the organization.
	The Executive Assistant will serve as the right hand to the executive leadership, providing highlevel strategic, operational, and administrative support.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing executive priorities, driving strategic projects, coordinating initiatives across departments, facilitating communication, tracking key deliverables, and ensuring seamless execution of business objectives.
	This role requires exceptional organizational skills, business acumen, discretion, strong project management capabilities, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Key Responsibilities
Executive Support:


	Manage the executive&#39;s calendar, appointments, travel arrangements, and daily priorities.
	Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, briefing notes, and executive correspondence.
	Screen communications, prioritize requests, and ensure timely follow-up on critical matters.
	Act as a trusted liaison between the executive and internal/external stakeholders.
	Anticipate executive needs and proactively resolve scheduling or operational challenges.


Strategic Project Management:


	Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of strategic business initiatives.
	Coordinate cross-functional projects from inception through completion, ensuring timelines and deliverables are achieved.
	Track project milestones, identify bottlenecks, and escalate issues where necessary.
	Develop project trackers, dashboards, and status reports for executive review.
	Conduct research, gather data, and prepare recommendations to support executive decision-making.


Cross-Functional Coordination:


	Coordinate activities across departments including Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience, Finance, HR, and Fitness Operations.
	Ensure alignment of departmental priorities with organizational objectives.
	Follow up with department heads on action items and key deliverables.
	Facilitate communication between teams to improve collaboration and accountability.
	Monitor execution of strategic initiatives and ensure timely completion.


Priority &amp; Performance Management:


	Maintain an executive action tracker and monitor progress on high-priority initiatives.
	Assist in setting organizational priorities and ensuring effective execution.
	Track KPIs, operational metrics, and departmental performance indicators.
	Prepare executive reports highlighting progress, risks, and recommendations.
	Ensure accountability by following up on commitments made during meetings.


Meeting &amp; Communication Management:


	Coordinate executive meetings, leadership meetings, and strategy sessions.
	Take accurate meeting minutes and distribute actionable follow-up items.
	Monitor completion of assigned action points across teams.
	Draft professional emails, presentations, business documents, and executive communications.
	Maintain confidentiality of sensitive company information.


Business Operations Support:


	Assist in improving internal processes and operational efficiency.
	Coordinate special projects and business initiatives as assigned.
	Maintain organized documentation and records for strategic initiatives.
	Support budgeting, vendor coordination, procurement, and administrative tasks where necessary.
	Perform other duties that contribute to the achievement of organizational goals.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Project Management, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Project Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, or similar strategic support role.
	Experience supporting C-suite executives or senior leadership is highly preferred.
	Experience working in a fast-paced startup, fitness, hospitality, healthcare, retail, or service-oriented environment is an advantage. Required Skills &amp; Competencies
	Excellent project management and execution skills. ? Strong organizational and time management abilities.
	Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
	Strong business and commercial acumen.
	High attention to detail with excellent problem-solving skills.
	Ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
	Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
	Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
	High level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
	Strong decision-making and prioritization skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) and Google Workspace.


Ideal Candidate Profile:


	The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, and execution-driven.
	They possess exceptional emotional intelligence, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and excel at bringing structure to fast-moving environments.
	They can anticipate needs before they arise, coordinate multiple teams simultaneously, and ensure strategic priorities are executed effectively.
	This individual thrives under pressure, exercises sound judgment, maintains absolute confidentiality, and serves as a dependable partner to executive leadership.


Salary
N400,000 &ndash; N450,000 Monthly.

Method of Applictaion&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: careers@elvaridah.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

	Prepare executive reports highlighting progress, risks, and recommendations.
	Ensure accountability by following up on commitments made during meetings.


Meeting & Communication Management:


	Coordinate executive meetings, leadership meetings, and strategy sessions.
	Take accurate meeting minutes and distribute actionable follow-up items.
	Monitor completion of assigned action points across teams.
	Draft professional emails, presentations, business documents, and executive communications.
	Maintain confidentiality of sensitive company information.


Business Operations Support:


	Assist in improving internal processes and operational efficiency.
	Coordinate special projects and business initiatives as assigned.
	Maintain organized documentation and records for strategic initiatives.
	Support budgeting, vendor coordination, procurement, and administrative tasks where necessary.
	Perform other duties that contribute to the achievement of organizational goals.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, Project Management, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Project Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, or similar strategic support role.
	Experience supporting C-suite executives or senior leadership is highly preferred.
	Experience working in a fast-paced startup, fitness, hospitality, healthcare, retail, or service-oriented environment is an advantage. Required Skills & Competencies
	Excellent project management and execution skills. ? Strong organizational and time management abilities.
	Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
	Strong business and commercial acumen.
	High attention to detail with excellent problem-solving skills.
	Ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
	Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
	Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
	High level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
	Strong decision-making and prioritization skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) and Google Workspace.


Ideal Candidate Profile:


	The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, and execution-driven.
	They possess exceptional emotional intelligence, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and excel at bringing structure to fast-moving environments.
	They can anticipate needs before they arise, coordinate multiple teams simultaneously, and ensure strategic priorities are executed effectively.
	This individual thrives under pressure, exercises sound judgment, maintains absolute confidentiality, and serves as a dependable partner to executive leadership.


Salary
N400,000 – N450,000 Monthly.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Procurement Manager",
  "description": "Clinton Health Access Initiative - Founded in 2002, by President William J. Clinton and Ira Magaziner, the Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to strengthening integrated health systems and expanding access to care and treatment in the developing world. CHAI&rsquo;s solution-oriented approach focuses on improving market dynamics for medicines and diagnostics; lowering prices for treatment; accelerating access to lifesaving technologies; and helping governments build the capacity required for high-quality care and treatment programs.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Procurement Manager

Job Location: Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Overview


	CHAI Nigeria is seeking a Procurement Manager to lead procurement.
	The position is based in Abuja and reports to the Country Director.
	This is a back-office role: you will own the end-to-end procurement cycle, manage a small procurement team, and hold the supplier relationships the office depends on.
	The role carries no grant management, donor reporting, or business development responsibilities.
	You will work independently, set the quality bar for the team&#39;s outputs, and exercise sound judgment where information is incomplete, while keeping every purchase compliant with CHAI policy, approved budgets, and Nigerian law.
	The successful candidate will embody CHAI&#39;s values, including humility, urgency, entrepreneurialism, trust and transparency, working at the service of government, diversity, and being mission-driven.


Responsibilities
Procurement delivery:


	Own the full procurement cycle: annual procurement plan, category strategies, and service standards for the office.
	Lead sourcing from specification through tendering, evaluation, award, contracting, and close-out.
	Coordinate a periodic procurement review with the team and report monthly against agreed key performance indicators, including lead times, savings realized, and delivery reliability.
	Keep every procurement action inside CHAI procurement policy, approved thresholds, and delegated authority limits, and exercise sound judgment where information is incomplete and waiting would put delivery at risk.


Compliance and risk:


	Keep every action inside CHAI policy, approved thresholds, and delegated authority, with documentation audit-ready at all times.
	Manage supplier, quality, pricing, and delivery risk, and maintain conflict-of-interest and vendor due diligence checks.
	Embed ethical and sustainable sourcing, anti-fraud and anti-corruption checks, and the development of qualified local suppliers.
	Ensure all procurement activity complies with CHAI procurement policy, internal controls, and applicable national procurement, tax, and import law, and always keep documentation audit-ready.
	Identify procurement and supply risks, including supplier concentration, quality, pricing, and delivery exposure, and put mitigations in place before they affect operations.
	Resolve escalations without compromising CHAI&rsquo;s compliance, ethics, or safeguarding standards, and maintain a clear conflict-of-interest and vendor due diligence process.


Suppliers and internal clients:


	Act as the single point of contact for program teams on specifications, timelines, and service expectations.
	Negotiate and manage framework agreements, run structured supplier reviews, and lead remediation or exit where performance falls short.
	Work with Finance, Legal, IT, and Administration to keep purchase-to-pay and contracting joined up end to end.
	Develop and maintain a vendor database and evolve strategies to improve vendor management and engagement, including setting up vendor forums for regular feedback and verification.

Procurement Manager Job at Clinton Health Access Initiative

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Procurement Manager

Job Location: Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Overview


	CHAI Nigeria is seeking a Procurement Manager to lead procurement.
	The position is based in Abuja and reports to the Country Director.
	This is a back-office role: you will own the end-to-end procurement cycle, manage a small procurement team, and hold the supplier relationships the office depends on.
	The role carries no grant management, donor reporting, or business development responsibilities.
	You will work independently, set the quality bar for the team's outputs, and exercise sound judgment where information is incomplete, while keeping every purchase compliant with CHAI policy, approved budgets, and Nigerian law.
	The successful candidate will embody CHAI's values, including humility, urgency, entrepreneurialism, trust and transparency, working at the service of government, diversity, and being mission-driven.


Responsibilities
Procurement delivery:


	Own the full procurement cycle: annual procurement plan, category strategies, and service standards for the office.
	Lead sourcing from specification through tendering, evaluation, award, contracting, and close-out.
	Coordinate a periodic procurement review with the team and report monthly against agreed key performance indicators, including lead times, savings realized, and delivery reliability.
	Keep every procurement action inside CHAI procurement policy, approved thresholds, and delegated authority limits, and exercise sound judgment where information is incomplete and waiting would put delivery at risk.


Compliance and risk:


	Keep every action inside CHAI policy, approved thresholds, and delegated authority, with documentation audit-ready at all times.
	Manage supplier, quality, pricing, and delivery risk, and maintain conflict-of-interest and vendor due diligence checks.
	Embed ethical and sustainable sourcing, anti-fraud and anti-corruption checks, and the development of qualified local suppliers.
	Ensure all procurement activity complies with CHAI procurement policy, internal controls, and applicable national procurement, tax, and import law, and always keep documentation audit-ready.
	Identify procurement and supply risks, including supplier concentration, quality, pricing, and delivery exposure, and put mitigations in place before they affect operations.
	Resolve escalations without compromising CHAI’s compliance, ethics, or safeguarding standards, and maintain a clear conflict-of-interest and vendor due diligence process.


Suppliers and internal clients:


	Act as the single point of contact for program teams on specifications, timelines, and service expectations.
	Negotiate and manage framework agreements, run structured supplier reviews, and lead remediation or exit where performance falls short.
	Work with Finance, Legal, IT, and Administration to keep purchase-to-pay and contracting joined up end to end.
	Develop and maintain a vendor database and evolve strategies to improve vendor management and engagement, including setting up vendor forums for regular feedback and verification.
	Manage the routine prequalification process for identifying new vendors and updating the vendor database.


Imports:


	Manage international purchases end to end: freight, customs clearance, import documentation, and tax exemption approvals.
	Process CHAI’s duty waiver applications to ensure timely and seamless clearance of imported items.


Team leadership:


	Line manage a small team of procurement staff: set clear annual objectives, hold regular one-to-ones, and complete mid-year and annual performance reviews.
	Coach staff on the procurement tools, templates, and frameworks they use, and set the quality bar for the team’s technical outputs.


Budget, analysis, and reporting:


	Manage procurement spend against approved budgets, reconcile monthly, and flag material variances early.
	Lead analyses that inform operational decisions, including make-or-buy, category, and total-cost-of-ownership assessments.
	Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, raise difficult messages early, and present practical options.
	Any other responsibilities assigned by the Country Director.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in supply chain management, procurement, business, engineering, or a related field; a master's degree or a CIPS, CPSM, or CSCP certification is an advantage.
	At least seven (7) years of progressively responsible procurement or supply chain experience, with direct accountability for the sourcing and contracting cycle.
	Experience running competitive tenders and serving on or chairing evaluation committees.
	Line management experience, including objective setting, performance reviews, and staff development.
	Experience procuring goods and services in a nonprofit, international organization, or multi-country environment.


Technical skills:


	Advanced Excel skills and hands-on experience with procurement or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
	Strong grasp of procurement controls, tender documentation, contract terms, and audit evidence requirements.
	Working knowledge of Nigerian import, customs, and tax exemption processes.
	Openness to learning generative artificial intelligence and other technologies to streamline the procurement function.


Competencies:


	Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to produce decision-ready materials for senior audiences.
	Negotiation and supplier relationship management, with the confidence to hold a position under pressure.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail.
